annotations.title: Italian SDI FatturaPA v1.2.2 Tax Validator & Sanitizer

description:
[Italian SDI FatturaPA v1.2.2 validator & tax sanitizer. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Validates and sanitizes Italian FatturaPA XML payloads (FPR12 B2B / FPA12 PA), verifying 7-character Codice Destinatario / PEC, Natura IVA codes (N1-N7), Split Payment deductions (Art. 17-ter), virtual stamp duty (€2.00 bollo virtuale), and withholding taxes.
Usage: Use this tool before submitting invoices to Sistema di Interscambio (SDI) to prevent statutory rejection codes (Scarto SDI).
Returns: JSON object with { numeroFattura: string, sdiTransmissionReady: boolean, formatoTrasmissione: string, codiceDestinatarioValido: boolean, totaliFinanziari: object, bloccoErroriSdi: array, avvertenzeFiscali: array }.

applicaRitenutaAccontoPercent.description: Withholding tax rate percentage (e.g. 20% for professional services)

cessionarioPartitaIvaOrCf.description: Buyer tax code or VAT number

codiceDestinatarioSdi.description: 7-char SDI recipient code (or 6-char for Public Administration, or 0000000 with PEC)

esigibilitaIva.description: VAT collectibility (I immediate, D deferred, S split payment)

isPubblicaAmministrazione.description: True if recipient is an Italian Public Administration (IPA)

pecDestinatario.description: Recipient PEC email address (mandatory if Codice Destinatario is 0000000)

regimeFiscale.description: Fiscal regime (RF01 ordinary, RF19 flat-rate forfettario)

naturaIva.description: Statutory Natura code if VAT is 0%

tipoDocumento.description: FatturaPA document type (e.g. TD01 invoice, TD04 credit note, TD16-19 reverse charge)
